scope: One uninstrumented CUDA Qwen3.5-2B window: five arms, R1 single-user single-turn and R1 single-user two consecutive turns. Two-turn is not B2. Current-window comparison only; no historical pooling or causal attribution.

images.role: retained local peer, not latest upstream

CLI_entry.contract: Original opaque int qwen35::run(int,char**) forwarding entry; no Model layout or backend types.

closure.identity_policy: Prior archives identify source/recipe/header ancestry only; their samples and overwritten old image paths are not current measurements.

hardware.compiler_and_native_versions: Exact compiler/SDK headers/dependency identities are in recorded build commands and actual-dependencies; fixed local peer433e is not latest upstream.

configuration: N1/R1/C1024, greedy, prefix-cache off; same P154 and at most64 natural outputs per turn. Ordinary off/auto; MTP K1 explicitly overlap-off. Original target-only/full-MTP GGUF mapping.
metric_order: Timing arrays are [median,min,max] from three unmonitored processes; unknown/null stays unknown/null. No significance claim.
metric_definitions: Prefill TPS uses actual target prefill rows and the complete producer prefill endpoint; two-turn pending flush work remains charged.
Decode TPS includes all draft/catchup, preparation, host and synchronization work in the original decode endpoint; numerator excludes each turn prefill first token.
Comprehensive session output TPS is all actual emitted IDs divided by prefill+decode; committed-context processed TPS is separately retained.
Ready, load, first-token and cold endpoint values are original producer host-wall observations, not GPU busy time or CPU execution time.
comparison_definition: 100*(named Hyle median / named reference median - 1); reference is retained peer or current Hyle ordinary-off. Descriptive, not paired-process significance or cross-window causal code gain.
memory_units: MiB (2^20 bytes). One independent monitored process, excluded from timing medians.

ready_baseline.definition: Last process-running sample between received ready and earliest actual prefill-begin; null when none exists.

consistency.detail_policy: Full ID differences, actual rounds/work, complete raw non-time oracle and process timing/index remain in the ZIP.

limits: Three timing observations and one independent memory observation per arm/scenario; medians/ranges are descriptive, without significance or broad quality claims.

No old-window samples or percentages enter this table. The current review Model/headers and retained native closure are jointly measured; this is not a causal code-gain experiment against older windows. Correctness builds are separately referenced.
Original 10ms-requested PSAPI/PDH sampling; actual gaps/nulls and ready samples are retained. Unknown readiness or unsupported counters are never replaced with zero.
Dedicated/shared GPU and working-set/private-commit RAM are distinct. GPU total uses same-sample sums; sampled maxima are lower bounds, not an exact CUDA allocation or physical VRAM maximum.
Logical shared backing/cache requested-byte telemetry is actual report data, not sampled physical RAM/VRAM peak.
Auto counts preserve each actual submission/publication/discard/refusal/final-availability result. Overlapping A/B step lifetimes cannot be summed as decode wall time.

Four-metric tables share workload family, generation policy and token budget, not bit-identical computed work. Within-arm complete reports are stable; actual cross-engine ID boundaries are retained without assuming equality or any old divergence index. Accepted rows/roles are retained.
No new EOS, fault, full hidden-state equality, concurrency beyond R1, other-platform, or latest-upstream claim is established by this performance window.
